text:
Do I understand correctly that you are married?
3 years since the first visa or did it take a while to receive it ?
I'm asking as most MH don't move the file if 75% (as far as I know it's 75%) was done already.
If not, I'd wait until you know where you are moving and have the new rental contract.
If your MH allows walk ins I'd go there and ask if you would need to move your file.
If you do, you notify the old MH first (after changing your address in your ID) and then ask if the new MH received your file.
